title: Publish DXP as a reproducible GitHub repository connected to DCE
goal: Create Milothik/domain-experience-protocol with the approved public DXP code and a pinned DCE dependency.
observation: Existing public kit contains the working kernel, CLI, UI, worker and reviewed evidence. DCE is a separate repository pinned by the adapter. The integration runner imports web/index.js although DCE builds dist/index.js.
alternatives: Import only approved release paths and pin DCE
selected: Import the reviewed public file mapping into an independent checkout and connect DCE through a pinned submodule.
action: Verify the imported project, fix the DCE build entry point, document architecture limits and add CI.
uncertainty: GitHub creation, remote push and clean-clone checks remain unobserved.
